info.title: Traigent Agent-head Pinned Config and Deploy Publication Routes
info.description: Exact pinned-version config read of the agent-head deploy target (TRAIG-101 plan 8.5). CARRIES CUSTOMER CONTENT: deliberately NOT a content-class lint root (explicit exception in scripts/content_class_lint.py EXPLICIT_CONTENT_EXCEPTIONS); outside the closed reactive contract and the Director bridge guarantee.

post.summary: Publish the approved candidate to the agent head (deploy branch)
post.description: The deploy branch of publication, separate from POST /api/v1/best-configs (whose rule is the generation captured at optimization start, never refreshed). Precondition here: expected_head_generation = the APPROVAL-TIME generation bound in the grant; a head move after approval is 409 head_generation_stale and the deploy is refused (deploy_refused) and needs a new approval. Authorization: reservation holder generation, valid human grant, current contract. Order: after authentication and binding validation, a same-key replay returns the stored original result BEFORE any stale-generation or mutable-effect check; for a new request under the head lock (best-config row first, head second): recheck stored result/tombstone, validate generation, publish; head advance and the occurrence-bound publish-result commit atomically in both the unchanged-spec and changed-spec branches. A tombstoned key answers 409 publication_cancelled and changes nothing. The caller reports the terminal outcome with a deploy_result carrying publish_result_key; the Backend accepts write=succeeded only against a succeeded record and write=failed/retries_exhausted only after finalization returned cancelled. Tenant and project come from the authenticated request context only (X-Tenant-Id, query strings and unknown body fields are never consulted or are refused). Dark behind PRODUCTION_REQUIREMENTS_ENABLED: while off the route answers the closed 404 {"success":false,"error":"reference_not_found","error_code":"reference_not_found","message":"Reference not found."} before authentication and body processing, indistinguishable from a missing or inaccessible reference. Every error body is the closed envelope ../optimization/tvl_reactive_common_schema.json#/definitions/Refusal except 429.

Closed envelope; nothing is echoed.
